limitations: The lifecycle is open and every mark, excursion, and counterfactual can change before the venue close.
The challenger estimates exclude future funding and additional exit slippage.
One prior close plus one open lifecycle is insufficient to establish a durable exit edge.
The current venue stop protects against a bounded adverse move but protects none of the open profit.
An opposite intent closes at its then-current executable price; it cannot guarantee preservation of the present unrealized PnL.
The regime assessment is causal descriptive context, not a calibrated probability of profit.
falsifier: Update this provisional assessment if the native lifecycle closes below any preregistered challenger after realized fees, funding, and slippage; if an eligible opposite intent fails to route an immediate close; if venue protection disappears; if source identity changes; or if exact ledger accounting no longer reconciles.

change_proposal.Evidence reviewed: Exact active execution plan, venue position and stop rows, latest HYPE provider evaluation, router implementation and tests, preregistered profit-lock challengers, the only prior compatible HYPE close, and the current causal regime path.
change_proposal.Observed problem or opportunity: Open profit is not venue-protected, but the native trend hold currently exceeds every preregistered generic profit-lock estimate and no opposite signal exists.
change_proposal.Applicable market regime: Current 1m, 5m, and 15m states are TREND_DOWN with 91.7% movement confidence; this is descriptive alignment, not a win probability.
change_proposal.Alternatives considered: Install a generic profit lock now, close immediately, wait only for the fixed stop, honor provider-recipe exits, or preserve the native opposite-intent and regime-aware time exit.

change_proposal.Main risks and failure modes: The trend can reverse before an eligible opposite onset, the backend-only opposite close can suffer latency or slippage, the venue stop allows the open profit to reverse into a loss, and this winner may be an outlier.
change_proposal.Validation completed: Current runtime identity and protection reconciled; opposite-intent route verified by code and 54 focused tests; challenger states compared at a frozen prefix; regime path has zero opposed decisions or coverage gaps.
change_proposal.Validation still required: Resolve the venue close, fees, funding, slippage, holding time, MFE giveback, exit reason, and each preregistered challenger on the identical causal lifecycle.
change_proposal.Success metrics: Immediate close on an eligible opposite intent; continuous venue stop protection; exact flat and order-free reconciliation; native realized net compared with all challengers; and route economics reported with and without the largest winner.
change_proposal.Failure / rollback triggers: Missing opposite-intent close, lost venue stop, stale or mismatched identity, accounting divergence, backend fault, or repeated independent native exits materially underperforming the frozen challengers.
change_proposal.Confidence level: High confidence in the implemented opposite-intent close and current venue protection; medium confidence that holding this specific aligned path is preferable at the current boundary; low confidence in durable HYPE profitability because compatible live N is one closed plus one open.
change_proposal.Explicit approval requested: No approval requested because no live change is proposed. Any later exit-policy change will require a separate versioned proposal and explicit approval.
